name: 时尚大片
description: 雕塑感布光与精细材质结合，色彩鲜明克制，具有高级杂志摄影气质。
rendering_prompt: Use the precise lighting of high-end editorial photography, emphasizing contours, volume, and materials through sculptural light-and-shadow transitions. Keep highlights clean, shadows delicate, and local contrast crisp. Make colors bold within a unified, restrained grade. Preserve microscopic surface textures for a refined, avant-garde image with a clear visual center. Avoid the plastic appearance of excessive surface smoothing.
avoid: 磨皮蜡感、无关服饰、失控高光
difference: 时尚大片重材质和精确轮廓光；电影剧照重叙事与影调
tuning: 收紧色盘，突出一种材质，保留微小表面纹理。
